messages:
anya-k: heads up — noticed a ~12% p95 token-latency regression on canary v2 after the kernel-selector change. model-compare dashboard: https://dash.redwood/model-compare?canary=v2 :rotating_light:
sam-m: link? can you paste the per-token waterfall and a quick summary?
anya-k: pasted numbers: p50=18ms, p95=72ms, p99=140ms; baseline v1 p95=64ms. The regression is concentrated on early tokens (positions 1-8).
liam-r: any KV cache evictions around those windows? early-token overhead usually points to miss + downstream KV lookup cost.
infra-bot: Deploy canary v2 at 1876543180, kernel-selector=xg-opt, batching=adaptive-128, kv-cache=enabled.
anya-k: quick PromQL we used for token breakdown:

```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket{model="gptx",route=~"/chat.*",version=~"v1|v2"}[5m])) by (le,version,route))
```

It shows divergence at the small token-position buckets (1-8).
kevin-s: can we add per-route p95 token delta to the model-compare dashboard? e.g. p95(v2)-p95(v1) by route and by kernel variant. Also include prefix_hit_rate and avg_batch_size panels.
liam-r: looked at kernel traces — xg-opt path inserts an extra short-lived kernel launch when continuous-batching closes early for short sequences. That extra launch is ~4-6ms overhead per request which matches the early-token spike.
eva-p: options: revert kernel-selector for canary, tweak batch idle timeout (favor continuous kernel), or tune KV prefetch threshold. My vote: quick A/B adjusting batch idle timeout to 2ms first.
sam-m: can we run an A/B with identical traffic split and measure per-route KPIs for 2 hours? I'll spin up an AB test for route=/chat/copilot -> 50/50.
anya-k: started AB @1876543300 with logs forwarding. will post p95 diffs in 30m. :eyes:
kevin-s: add alert: p95_token_delta_v2_vs_v1 > 10ms sustained for 15m -> page eng-runtime.
liam-r: also adding KV evictions metric to canary dashboard: kv_evictions_total by instance and prefix_hit_rate to correlate.
infra-bot: AB test created: ab-test-id=ab-20260315-1, traffic_split=50/50, start=1876543300.
anya-k: model-compare per-route KPI query to use in panels:

```
max(p95_token_latency_ms{test="ab-20260315-1"}) by (route,version)
```
eva-p: if AB shows no improvement, revert kernel selector on canary and iterate on kernel patch (reduce extra launch or route short seqs to the legacy kernel).
sam-m: thanks all — keep updates here, and post the first 30/60/120m diffs. :thumbsup:
